card.name: Pieces of Linux web file paths
card.fires_on: Pieces of Unix file paths in shell commands, mostly "www" after /srv or /var, and the start of names like dbmmanage or fsaclctl in /usr/bin and /usr/sbin.

modes.label: www in server paths
modes.description: The directory name www right after /srv or /var in SELinux and Apache examples.
modes.example: # restorecon -Rv /srv<</www>> The SELinux policies here use regular

modes.label: Inside admin command names
modes.description: A piece of a command or file name under /usr/bin or /usr/sbin, such as dbmmanage or fsaclctl.
modes.example: /usr/bin/db<<m>>manage To create a username and password
